top_signals.title: Roughed-Up Bond Traders Look to Fedspeak, Minutes for Next Move
top_signals.summary: Bond traders fresh off a bruising week will look to a slew of Federal Reserve speeches and the central bank’s most recent meeting minutes for clues on interest rates after the market ramped up expectations for an extended cycle of hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
